instruction: Locate the information about obtaining a REAL ID

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from Virginia DMV homepage to the REAL ID information page. Uses the same evaluator pattern as original (URL regex match via accessibility tree). Similar complexity - requires 1-2 navigation clicks. Regex allows for path variations.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: user must navigate to Virginia DMV REAL ID information page
Getter logic is correct: active_url_from_accessTree extracts the active Chrome tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match applies regex pattern matching to verify the URL
Expected value is semantically correct: regex pattern '^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov/(licenses-ids|general)/real-id' accurately targets REAL ID pages on Virginia DMV website
Complete coverage: single-step task (navigate to page) is fully verified by URL check
Path flexibility: regex allows variation in URL structure (licenses-ids OR general) to handle potential site changes
Data flow is correct: URL extraction → regex matching → binary result (1.0/0.0)
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 if URL is None/empty, handles both string URLs and dict with 'url' field
No postconfig needed: URL verification works immediately after navigation
